## Sources

Every new claim, date and number needs a source a reader can open. Name the page or chapter.

## Checklist

- [ ] Events carry a `track`, a `basis` and at least one source.
- [ ] Disputed figures are ranges with their authors named, or marked `contested`.
- [ ] Figures that change over time carry the date they were true on.
- [ ] Historical boundaries are marked as approximate.
- [ ] `bun run build` passes.
